instruction: A candid documentary photograph with a wide, eye-level shot captures an indoor motion capture studio with a dark red carpeted floor, white walls, and wall-mounted cameras. The man in the black cap and blue shorts (R1) stands on the left, leaning back with a slight smile. The woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on the right, leaning forward and pushing him with both hands on his chest, her right leg extended backward. There are no bystanders in the room. Bright overhead lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
